qualify.name: Reject non-tag dispatch before checkout or API access
qualify.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, re
assert os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_NAME'] == 'workflow_dispatch'
assert os.environ['GITHUB_REF_TYPE'] == 'tag'
assert re.fullmatch(r'refs/tags/v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+', os.environ['GITHUB_REF'])
assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA'])
assert os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'] == os.environ['EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA']
assert re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', os.environ['CI_RUN_ID'])
PY

qualify.name: Verify exact tag and successful CI metadata before artifact download
Bind exact CI context and package version to actual tag
qualify.run:
python3 tools/release_version.py --check
test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/tags/v$(python3 tools/release_version.py --print-version)"
python3 tools/qualify_release.py --context eqnedit64-ci-release-context/context.json --report qualification.json --output "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

signed-standalone.name: Download the signed standalone prepared for this tag
signed-standalone.run:
$version = $env:EQNEDIT64_TAG.Substring('v'.Length)
$dest = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'eqnedit64-draft'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest | Out-Null
# Download canonical names from the unpublished, exact-SHA draft.
foreach ($item in @(@("EqnEdit64.exe", 100000),
                    @("EqnEdit64.release.json", 1),
                    @("SHA256SUMS.txt", 1))) {
  $name = $item[0]
  python tools/download_release_asset.py `
    --repo $env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY `
    --tag $env:EQNEDIT64_TAG `
    --source-sha $env:EQNEDIT64_SHA `
    --name $name `
    --min-size $item[1] `
    --dest $dest
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw ("The signed standalone for $env:EQNEDIT64_TAG is not staged: " +
      "$name is missing from the exact unpublished draft. " +
      'Stage the signed candidate before creating the release tag.')
  }
}

signed-standalone.name: Verify the signed standalone against the tag
signed-standalone.run:
$releaseRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'eqnedit64-draft'
$exe = Join-Path $releaseRoot 'EqnEdit64.exe'
$manifestPath = Join-Path $releaseRoot 'EqnEdit64.release.json'
Write-Host "Verifying staged release payload: $releaseRoot"
$manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Raw |
  ConvertFrom-Json
$allowedKeys = @('schema', 'repository', 'tag', 'version', 'source_sha', 'exe_sha256')
$actualKeys = @($manifest.PSObject.Properties.Name)
if (@(Compare-Object $allowedKeys $actualKeys).Count -ne 0) {
  throw 'Unexpected manifest fields; private metadata must not be published'
}
$expectedVersion = $env:EQNEDIT64_TAG.Substring('v'.Length)
$actualHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $exe).Hash
$actualVersion = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $exe).VersionInfo.ProductVersion
$signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $exe
$pin = $env:EQNEDIT64_SIGNER_SHA256
if ($pin -notmatch '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{64}$') { throw 'Signer SHA256 setting required' }
$actualPin = [Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData($signature.SignerCertificate.RawData))
if ($actualPin -cne $pin.ToUpperInvariant()) { throw 'Signer certificate mismatch' }
$store = [Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Store]::new('Root', 'LocalMachine')
try {
  $store.Open('ReadWrite')
  $store.Add($signature.SignerCertificate)
} finally { $store.Close() }
$signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $exe
if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid') { throw 'Invalid staged signature after pinned trust setup' }

if ($manifest.schema -cne 'eqnedit64.staged-release.v1' -or
    $manifest.tag -cne $env:EQNEDIT64_TAG -or
    $manifest.version -cne $expectedVersion -or
    $manifest.source_sha -cne $env:EQNEDIT64_SHA -or
    $manifest.exe_sha256 -cne $actualHash -or
    $actualVersion -cne $expectedVersion -or
    $manifest.repository -cne $env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY) {
  throw ('The staged signed EqnEdit64 does not match this tag. ' +
    'It must be the executable compiled and signed from the exact ' +
    'tagged commit, staged by the maintainer signing step before the release tag.')
}

$artifact = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'eqnedit64-signed-standalone'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $artifact | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $exe -Destination $artifact
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Destination $artifact
$stagedChecksum = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $releaseRoot 'SHA256SUMS.txt') -Raw
if ($stagedChecksum.Trim() -cne ($actualHash.ToLowerInvariant() + '  EqnEdit64.exe')) { throw 'Staged checksum mismatch' }
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $releaseRoot 'SHA256SUMS.txt') -Destination $artifact

build-wheels.name: Validate tag and package versions
Verify installed wheel outside the repository
Inspect exact built wheel and embedded executable before upload

audit-wheels.name: Bind all four wheels before requesting human approval
audit-wheels.run:
python tools/check_release_wheels.py --wheel-dir dist --standalone standalone/EqnEdit64.exe --version "${EQNEDIT64_TAG#v}" --source-sha "$EQNEDIT64_SHA" --report wheel-audit.json
args=(--artifact standalone/EqnEdit64.exe --artifact standalone/EqnEdit64.release.json)
for wheel in dist/*.whl; do args+=(--artifact "$wheel"); done
python tools/check_release_versions.py "${args[@]}"

publish.name: Recheck actual tag CI and context after human approval
Recheck downloaded CI tag context after approval
Verify all draft assets before any publication
Reject development labels before publication
publish.run:
set -euo pipefail
python tools/release_version.py --check
args=(--artifact standalone/EqnEdit64.exe --artifact standalone/EqnEdit64.release.json --artifact web/equation-editor.js --artifact web/equation-editor.fragment.html)
for wheel in dist/*.whl; do args+=(--artifact "$wheel"); done
python tools/check_release_versions.py "${args[@]}"

publish.name: Bind all four wheels to the signed standalone and canonical Web blobs
Publish the preverified draft GitHub Release
publish.run:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s' '{"draft":false,"prerelease":false,"make_latest":"true"}' |
  gh api --method PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$DRAFT_RELEASE_ID" --input - > /dev/null
